a4Construct.label: After a Geo Construct
a4Construct.reason: Needs a party member to make a Geo Construct, which depends on the team.

a1Infusion.label: Geo infusion after her Skill
a1Infusion.reason: Her usual play takes the Tapestry follow-up (press the Skill again and switch out); the Tailoring Geo infusion comes only when she stays on the field, for 5 seconds against a cooldown of about 16, so it covers only part of her Normal and Charged Attacks. It is counted when it is switched on here, and it was checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.
